purpose_ko: 후속 사건을 평균내기 전에 비선형 표현으로 바꾸어, 같은 평균을 가진 서로 다른 관측 이력이 다음 사건 예측에 기여할 수 있는지 검증한다.

evidence.scope: all three datasets complete; seed42 validation; current successor candidate fails common gates
facts: Intermittent candidate RMSE/MAE are 28.5185%/24.6405% above same-run B.
Taxi candidate RMSE/MAE are 0.7906%/1.7704% below same-run B; legacy time guard fails.
Current additional memory path pools two log event features before a linear 2-to-H map.
With latent states and addressing weights fixed, equal weighted feature means imply identical current memory corrections. The correction lies in a subspace of dimension at most two.
Instacart successor RMSE/MAE changes vs B are +0.1909279%/-0.0373912%; same-event control has lower RMSE than both.
not_established: The rank/aggregation restriction caused either observed performance failure.
The entire B encoder cannot distinguish the compared histories.
A richer value representation fixes time loss or raw-RMSE objective mismatch.

alternatives.name: nonlinear_individual_outcome_values
alternatives.reason: One explicit representation change with a same-parameter pooling-order control; preserves existing causal records and addressing.

alternatives.name: task_specific_internal_memory_addresses
alternatives.reason: May allow time and quantity to retrieve different histories, but shared-address failure is unproven and disentangling added routing capacity requires more controls. Head-only separation is not this proposal.

alternatives.name: null_retrieval_or_content_dependent_forgetting
alternatives.reason: Absolute support gating and content-dependent retention already exist in prior project variants; poor-match retrieval has not been established as the present failure cause.

architecture.baseline: fresh titantpp B; existing encoder and final static Hard-LMM
architecture.records_and_addressing: exact successor completed-pair adjacency, observed masks, predecessor keys, query projection, affine-free LayerNorm and rank16 softmax from current successor design
architecture.value_map: phi(x)=GELU(V*x+b), V:[16,2], b:[16]; exact GELU approximate=none
architecture.shared_task_state: return(z,z); original quantity softplus/head and legacy time head unchanged
architecture.empty_or_unobserved_query: force c_t and correction to exact zero in BOTH routes, including after phi in control; phi(0) is not generally zero because b is trainable
architecture.invalid_record: sanitize unobserved/padded values before nonlinear operations and exclude them from weighted reduction; never rely on zero times NaN
architecture.state_lifetime: per sample, reconstructed per forward; same history cap; no cross-batch or external cache
architecture.structural_defaults: address rank16 and value width16 fixed across datasets; no validation-dependent widths, gates, quantile rules, clipping changes or loss changes

distinctions.current_successor: Changes nonlinear transformation order relative to outcome pooling, not the predecessor-successor addressing rule.
distinctions.observed_slot: Slot memory aggregates encoder hidden states into learned slots between layers. This design preserves individual completed event pairs and transforms their observed outcomes before final retrieval.
distinctions.dual_timescale: Does not use hidden innovations, recent/old compressed stores, write confidence or support gates.
distinctions.memory_film: No new scale/shift or query-conditioned fusion path.
distinctions.novelty: Nonlinear pooling is established prior art. This proposal is a project-specific, unvalidated architecture hypothesis, not an established novel contribution.

initialization_and_training_contract_req.shared_B: Exact same fresh baseline state and original RNG/dropout/data order; B parameters remain trainable in all arms.
initialization_and_training_contract_req.new_parameters: Same Q/K/V/b/U tensors in control and candidate, created with isolated RNG; U=zeros; V uses nn.Linear default weight initialization, b=zeros. Record exact generator state and constructor order at implementation freeze.
initialization_and_training_contract_req.initial_guarantee: Predictions/objective/shared B gradients agree before global clipping. New U gradients may differ, so first clipped optimizer steps need not agree.
initialization_and_training_contract_req.gradient_check: Nonzero U and nondegenerate unequal records are required when checking Q/K/V/b gradients and mechanism dependence.
initialization_and_training_contract_req.comparison: B, post-pool control, pre-pool candidate; proposed seed42/batch128/120epochs/noearlystop with identical split, target population and batch order per dataset. This is not an execution permit.
initialization_and_training_contract_req.selection: earliest strict finite validation raw-RMSE minimum; all selected metrics at the same checkpoint; epoch120 and last30 statistics reported separately
initialization_and_training_contract_req.additional_association_control: A nonlinear same-event control is required before attributing any gain to predecessor-successor association itself; pooling-order comparison alone cannot support that claim.

acceptance_proposal.scope: Inherit current seven gates against BOTH fresh B and post-pool control; do not relax after results. Final execution contract still required.
acceptance_proposal.time_interpretation: Legacy clamped time loss is a provisional structural comparison guard, not normalized Time NLL.
acceptance_proposal.reject_or_defer: No mechanism claim if candidate does not beat capacity control; no common candidate adoption if a dataset fails; no superiority claim from this reused single-seed validation.

cost.projection_and_activation: Both evaluate the same 2-to-16 map on B*L rows in the full-sequence API; autograd workload can still differ.
cost.weighted_value_read: candidate O(B*L^2*16), control O(B*L^2*2); score attention remains O(B*L^2*16) in both
cost.measurement_required: actual forward/backward/clip/AdamW step time and peak memory for B/control/candidate at batch128 and L64/L256; CPU before separately authorized native CUDA

implementation_map_proposed.reuse: completed_pairs and causal addressing semantics; keep current frozen successor source unchanged
implementation_map_proposed.checkpoint_identity: distinct pre-pool/post-pool IDs; bind activation, widths, association, mask semantics, source and optimizer/selector/RNG state; reject cross-route relabeling

validation_before_execution: Equal feature means but different outcome composition: distinguish with pre-pool nonlinear map at fixed latent/addressing/nonzero U.
Single record, identical values and affine-map replacement: both pooling orders agree in the valid cases.
Empty/unobserved row with nonzero b and U: exact zero correction in both routes.
Independent scalar causal-prefix oracle; future target dt/quantity, masks and no unobserved bridge; test with nonzero U.
Same initial B outputs/objective/shared preclip gradients and RNG; nondegenerate new-parameter gradients.
Same batch exposure; strict earliest ties; exact checkpoint/optimizer/RNG/loader/selector resume and route identity rejection.
Measured cost within frozen limits; no real-data inference or training is performed by design sanity checks.
limitations: Finite nonlinear feature averages still discard information and cannot represent every outcome distribution.
Richer values may overfit; one shared address and shared correction remain.
No guarantee of preserving or improving Taxi time performance or Intermittent quantity errors.
Current validation has been reused for architecture selection; later multi-seed validation and a separately authorized final held-out assessment remain necessary.
